## What it is

Completed with a partner, this project investigates how NCAA schools measure up to the requirements of Title IX using 
the Equity in Athletics Dataset published by the Department of Education. We used R to clean and combine data from 
2007-2024, from which we selected four core issues to focus on: ratios of student aid vs. participation, coaches' salaries, 
investment in men's and women's sports, and revenue generated. These visualizations reveal heavy gender disparities between 
both divisions and schools with and without football, indicating that more needs to be done to ensure that women's college 
sports reach their full potential.

## What I did

- Cleaned and combined nearly 20 years' worth of data from the [EADA](https://ope.ed.gov/athletics/#/) dataset.
- Created a series of interactive visualizations to display the continued lack of investment in women's college sports.
- Wrote and published a blog-style writeup (linked below) containing our visualizations and findings.
